title: Polish Mushroom Pasta
description: A hearty and flavorful pasta dish from Poland, featuring sautéed mushrooms in a butter and cream sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the yellow polish pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Season the sauce with salt to taste.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the mushroom sauce. Toss to combine.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
